text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unable to ignore a stage as grand as the 
Japanese Derby, Manhattan Cafe entered the 
race, but was unable to secure victory.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A heavy toll was placed on the body at the 
same time. Together with Agnes Tachyon, we 
set out to provide thorough care and 
treatment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
In the end, it turned out to be nothing 
serious, keeping hopes alive for the 
autumn races.
